column3: grep -E '\.cs$' | while IFS= read -r f; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; if grep -qE 'public\s+override\s+bool\s+Equals\s*\(' "$f" && ! grep -qE 'public\s+override\s+int\s+GetHashCode\s*\(' "$f"; then grep -nE 'public\s+override\s+bool\s+Equals\s*\(' "$f" | head -1 | awk -v f="$f" '{print f":"$0}'; fi; done
